messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 6 of Act 33/2019, amending s29A ()
Instruction (start): for sub-section (1), the following sub-section shall be substituted, namely:— “(1) The award in matters other than international commercial arbitration shall be made by the arbitral tribunal within a period of twelve months from the date of completion of pleadings under sub-section (4) of section 23: Provided that the award in the matter of international commercial arbitration may be made as exped

Source: Lok Sabha debate, 1 Aug 2019: consideration of the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2019 as passed by Rajya Sabha (SHRI KODIKUNNIL SURESH (MAVELIKKARA))
Quote: So, what this Act is particularly trying to do is make the whole thing more efficient, bring justice at the
doorsteps and help people resolve their commercial disputes.

Claim: The amendment aims to make the arbitration process more efficient and to bring justice to the doorsteps of people by helping resolve commercial disputes promptly.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"Quote states purpose and covers efficiency of arbitration, matching claim."}
